$comment: COMMITTED, NON-SECRET PRODUCTION DEFAULTS ONLY — the same rule as appsettings.json.
Every secret (Database__ConnectionString, Pins__*, Cloudinary__*) comes from /etc/gras/api.env
on the VPS. See docs/DEPLOYMENT.md.
PRODUCTION ONLY. Staging runs as ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Staging (backend/Dockerfile), so none
of this loads there: it gets every value as an environment variable instead.
Nginx terminates TLS on the same host and proxies to Kestrel on loopback. Without this the
rate limiter, the portal's per-address pin limits and every audit row's source_ip would all
see 127.0.0.1, and UseHttpsRedirection would redirect requests that already arrived over TLS.
STAGING DOES NOT USE THIS FILE: the Render image runs with ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Staging,
so none of these values load there and its KnownProxies list is empty to begin with. It sets
Proxy__Enabled=true and Proxy__TrustAllProxies=true as environment variables, which the
validator accepts only because no allow-list is present to contradict them. (A JSON array
cannot be emptied by an environment variable, so overriding this file's list is not possible
and is not the mechanism.)
The CSRF signing key ring. Persisted so a restart or a redeploy does not invalidate every
outstanding CSRF token. The provisioning script creates this directory owned by the service
account, mode 0700; the keys are plain XML and those permissions are what protects them.
The admin web app's exact origin, and nothing else. The parent portal is server-rendered by
this same process and makes no cross-origin call, so it does not belong here.
CONFIRM BEFORE FIRST DEPLOY: the frontend must be served from a goldenroyalark.com subdomain.
A *.netlify.app origin would be cross-SITE, and the __Host- session cookie (SameSite=Lax)
would not be sent — every sign-in would fail. Override with Cors__AllowedOrigins__0 to change
it without a redeploy.
Printed on every pin slip and encoded into every result QR code. CONFIRM THE SUBDOMAIN BEFORE
THE FIRST PIN BATCH IS PRINTED — slips already handed to parents cannot be corrected.
PdfCacheDirectory holds rendered result PDFs, cached per (result set, pupil, revision); it is
a cache, so losing it costs a re-render and nothing else.

Cloudinary.$comment: Credentials come from the environment. Only the folder prefix is not a secret.

Observability.$comment: No collector on the VPS: logs go to the journal via stdout. Sampling stays at 1.0 for one small instance.

$comment-AllowedHosts: Requests for any other Host are rejected with a 400, so a stray DNS record pointed at this box
cannot serve the app. localhost stays on the list because the deploy's own smoke test and the
systemd health probe call http://127.0.0.1:5000/health/live directly, bypassing Nginx.
